catalog.label: Element catalog
catalog.place: Drag into the viewport, or click to place it at the center of the view.
catalog.customReady: Imported model: {name}.glb — drag it into the viewport or click to place it at the center.
catalog.customHint: Import a .glb file to enable it (Import or Ctrl+I).
catalog.customToast: Import a .glb model first (Import or Ctrl+I).
catalog.offTerrain: Point the center of the view at the terrain to place the element.

panel.label: Properties
panel.title: Properties
panel.emptyHint: Click an object in the viewport to edit its properties, or press N to step through the elements.

brush.title: Terrain brush
brush.hint: Left button raises · Shift lowers · Esc leaves the tool.

sim.title: Simulation
sim.hintCable: A failed cable is skipped by Dijkstra; the route is recomputed.
sim.hintNode: Pick origin and destination and compute the path in the simulator.

multi.hint: Shift+click adds or removes · Shift+drag selects an area · the gizmo moves the batch.

env.hint: The hour moves the sun, the sky and the shadows (A18). Saved with the project, outside undo.

paint.title: Material brush
paint.hint: Drag to paint · “Auto” restores the altitude gradient · Esc leaves.

veg.title: Vegetation
veg.hint: Drag to plant up to the density · Shift erases · Esc leaves.

road.toolHint: Click the terrain for each point · Enter or double click finishes · Backspace removes the last one · Esc cancels.

cableTool.title: Cable tool
cableTool.hint: Click the origin element, then the destination. Esc cancels.

markerTool.title: Marker tool
markerTool.hint: Click the terrain or an element to drop a labeled pin. Esc cancels.

ruler.title: Ruler
ruler.hintStart: Click the terrain for the 1st point. R or Esc leaves.
ruler.hintSecond: Click the 2nd point — the label shows the distance to the cursor.
ruler.hintDone: Click again for another measurement · R or Esc leaves.

entity.label: Label
entity.hint: Gizmo: W move · E rotate · T scale. Editing X/Z snaps it back to the terrain.

dyn.hint: The type is inferred from the value: number, true/false (boolean) or text.

sim.label: Network simulator
sim.title: Simulator
sim.noPath: No active path between the origin and the destination.
sim.budgetMissing: Link budget: needs “power” at the origin and “sensitivity” at the destination.
sim.coverage: Coverage of {id}: {pct}% of the area in range with a signal above {dbm} dBm.

viewport.label: 3D viewport
viewport.canvas: 3D view — arrows move the camera, Shift+arrows rotate it, + and − zoom, Space clicks the crosshair
viewport.minimap: Minimap — click to move the camera

recovery.title: Recover unsaved work?
recovery.text: The app closed without saving. There is an automatic copy of the latest work.

unsaved.title: You have unsaved changes
unsaved.text: Do you want to save the project before continuing?

update.title: Update available
update.text: Terra_Map {version} is out. Download it from the releases page and replace this copy — updating is optional.

actions.focus: Focus the camera on the selection
actions.tab: Move through panels, buttons and the viewport
actions.space: Click the crosshair, at the center of the view

terrain.title: Terrain
terrain.text: In the Terrain group pick Flat, Mountains, Valley or Custom. Sculpt with the Brush (B); Shift lowers the relief.

infra.title: Infrastructure
infra.text: Drag houses, buildings and lots onto the terrain (or click them to place them at the center). Edit phase, position, rotation and scale in the right panel; W/E/T switch the gizmo.

network.title: Network
network.text: Drag OLTs, splitters, ONUs and antennas. Connect them with the Cable tool (C): click the origin, then the destination.

props.title: Properties
props.text: Every element and cable has dynamic properties (bandwidth, latency, power…) that feed the simulator.

simulate.title: Simulate
simulate.text: In the panel, mark Origin and Destination and press Compute. “Failed” tests the alternative route; on antennas, Simulate coverage.

productivity.title: Undo and layers
productivity.text: Ctrl/Cmd+Z undoes (up to 100 actions). Shift+click adds to the selection; Ctrl/Cmd+C/V copies and pastes. L opens Layers and History.

environment.title: Environment
environment.text: In the Environment group: time of day, fog and water, material brush, vegetation, roads and the presentation mode.

report.title: Measure and report
report.text: R measures distances and shows the terrain profile. “Report” gives statistics, the bill of materials and scenarios, and exports PDF and CSV.

keyboard.title: Keyboard and theme
keyboard.text: Tab reaches the viewport: arrows move the camera, Space clicks the crosshair, N jumps to the next element. The sun/moon button in the top bar switches the theme.

save.title: Save
save.text: Ctrl/Cmd+S saves the project (.json). An automatic copy every minute lets you recover after a crash.

terrain.title: 1. Create the terrain
terrain.text: In the highlighted catalog, pick Mountains or Valley (or sculpt with the Brush, B). Try it now — the catalog is active.

elements.title: 2. Place and connect elements
elements.text: Drag a house or an OLT into the highlighted viewport (or click the item to place it at the center). Connect elements with the Cable (C). From the keyboard: Tab to the viewport, arrows and Space.

save.title: 3. Save and show
save.text: In the highlighted bar: Save (Ctrl/Cmd+S), Report (PDF with the bill of materials) and the theme. The ? button in the corner has the shortcuts and the guide.

report.title: Report — {name}
report.bomEmpty: No network materials — place elements and cables from Networks & Telecom.
report.pricesNote: Symbolic prices and labor: catalog per kind or the “price” prop; cables by “costPerMeter”.
report.noSimulation: No simulation computed — pick origin and destination and compute the path in the simulator.
report.scenariosHint: “Save scenario” snapshots the current metrics into the project; change the network and compare them side by side with the current state.

profile.title: Terrain profile
profile.tooShort: First measure two different points with the ruler (R).
profile.chart: Terrain profile — the arrows step through the samples

toast.recovered: Work recovered. Save the project so you do not lose it.
toast.cableSame: Pick a different element as the cable destination.
toast.roadTooShort: A road needs at least 2 points.
